topic: Zero total budget must fail, not hide grants
lesson: All three lenses found the same defect at agent-prompt-capability-guidance.ts:49: 'if (input.totalBudget <= 0 || input.blocks.length === 0) return ""' returns an empty block before the overflow check, so with a non-zero grantedCount every granted capability disappears silently — the exact never-hide violation this task exists to prevent, and worse than the overflow case because nothing is recorded. Fix: when grantedCount is greater than zero and the compact lines cannot be rendered, take the SAME hard-overflow path as the normal branch (abort with the redacted capability_catalog_overflow diagnostic naming granted and renderable counts). Only an empty granted set may return early. Cover it with a test at zero and at a negative budget.
